background: BSc in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics from Northwestern Polytechnical University of China (2012). Backend developer at Tencent working on Tencent Weibo (2012-2014). Joined Futu Securities (Tencent-invested Hong Kong stock brokerage, 2015). First Bitcoin involvement in 2013. Led R&D at ZeusMiner (top 3 Scrypt miner). Founded ViaBTC mining pool in April 2016. Founded CoinEx cryptocurrency exchange in December 2017. Pioneer in Bitcoin Cash ecosystem.
latest_projects: CoinEx exchange - global cryptocurrency exchange. ViaBTC mining pool. Expanding exchange services globally.
